blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Could you hand me the remote?
exercises.why: **передать → передашь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's sing a patriotic song.
exercises.why: **спеть → споём** — present-type form, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Let's lie on the sand.
exercises.why: **прилечь → приляжем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: Here, have an apple for now.
exercises.why: **съесть → съешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Scroll down to the bottom of the page.
exercises.why: **прокрутить → Прокрутите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Shine the light over here, please.
exercises.why: **посветить → Посветите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Было бы приданое, а в невесты и козлиха ___ (сгодиться).
exercises.prompt: If there's a dowry, even a goat will serve as a bride.
exercises.why: **сгодиться → сгодится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let us settle the matter without a third party.
exercises.why: **уладить → уладим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: You'll soon get used to the change of climate.
exercises.why: **акклиматизироваться → акклиматизируетесь** — present-type form, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He's running against the wind.
exercises.why: **бежать → бежит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Готов поспорить с тобой, что первым ___ (добежать) до дерева.
exercises.prompt: I'll bet that I can beat you to the tree.
exercises.why: **добежать → добегу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I shop here all the time.
exercises.why: **закупаться → закупаюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я надеялся, что пунш ___ (разрешить) язык моего старого знакомца.
exercises.prompt: I hoped that some punch would loosen the tongue of my old friend.
exercises.why: **разрешить → разрешит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Меня не выпишут, пока я не ___ (вылечиться).
exercises.prompt: I won't be discharged until I'm cured.
exercises.why: **вылечиться → вылечусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Will you dance with me?
exercises.why: **потанцевать → потанцуете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: This dream will come true.
exercises.why: **воплотиться → воплотится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Don't use too much glue.
exercises.why: **переборщить → переборщите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll pick her up in an hour.
exercises.why: **подобрать → подберу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Don't tell Tom. He'll tell everyone.
exercises.why: **растрезвонить → растрезвонит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: The police are looking into it.
exercises.why: **расследовать → расследует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
